/** Three crown spikes with open underside; a diamond sits above the crown. */
export function supernovaReferenceStrokes() {
  const path = points => points.map(([x,y]) => ({x,y}));
  return [path([[45,165],[35,110],[67.5,142],[100,110],[132.5,142],[165,110],[155,165]]),
    path([[100,25],[126,60],[100,95],[74,60],[100,25]])];
}

/** Geometric whole-symbol matching plus isolated QuickDraw assistance, with offline fallback. */
export async function recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent) {
  const normalized = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(normalized);
  if (!bounds) return {valid:false,reason:'Draw the Supernova pattern.'};
  const width = bounds.right-bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const split = bounds.top + height*.53;
  const upper = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y<split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const lower = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y>=split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const diamondBounds=drawingBounds(upper), crownBounds=drawingBounds(lower);
  // The narrow diamond sits above the wider crown; reject enclosing circles/partial symbols.
  if (!diamondBounds || !crownBounds || diamondBounds.right-diamondBounds.left>width*.75 ||
      crownBounds.right-crownBounds.left<width*.75 || diamondBounds.bottom-diamondBounds.top<height*.25) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a diamond above an open-bottom three-spike crown.'};
  }
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes,supernovaReferenceStrokes());
  if (accuracy < .62) return {valid:false, reason:'Draw an open-bottom three-spike crown and a diamond.'};
  const components = [];
  for (const stroke of normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes)) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};

VERBATIM AGGREGATED_OUTPUT:
/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'){
    const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,decagrammatonReferenceStrokes());
    const valid=accuracy>=.72;return {valid,skillId:'decagrammaton-ultimate',label:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',score:accuracy,accuracy,matchAccuracy:accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,reason:valid?undefined:'Draw a square overlaid with a diamond.'};
  }
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if(weapon?.id==='princess-key')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'wakamo-bayonet') return recognizeBayonetChargePattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'orbital-compass') return recognizeOrbitalCompassPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'water-dousing') return recognizeSplashPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'student-handbook') return recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'throwing-cards') return recognizeSkilledThrowPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'molotov-cocktail') return recognizeMolotovPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'luminous-nova') return recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  if(recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes).valid)return {valid:false,reason:'This is the Strict Rules circle-and-plus pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  // CLIP can confuse overlapping frames with Umbrella's enclosing circle. Local geometry wins.
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return {valid:false,reason:'This is a linked-frame pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  const charge=recognizeBayonetChargePattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if(charge.valid){const weapon=skills.find(w=>w.id==='wakamo-bayonet'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0));return weapon?{...charge,weapon}:{valid:false,reason:'Charge! is not equipped or is on cooldown.'};}
  const compass=recognizeOrbitalCompassPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if(compass.valid){const weapon=skills.find(w=>w.id==='orbital-compass'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0));return weapon?{...compass,weapon}:{valid:false,reason:'This Direction? is not equipped or is on cooldown.'};}
  const strict=recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if(strict.valid){const weapon=skills.find(w=>w.id==='student-handbook'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0));return weapon?{...strict,weapon}:{valid:false,reason:'Strict Rules is not equipped or is on cooldown.'};}
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = ['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'wakamo-bayonet' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,bayonetChargeReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'orbital-compass' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,orbitalCompassReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'water-dousing' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,splashReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'student-handbook' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,strictRulesReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'throwing-cards' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,skilledThrowReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'molotov-cocktail' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,molotovReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: result.matchAccuracy??accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || candidate.matchAccuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}

  }
  return {valid:true,skillId:'supernova-beam',label:'Supernova',score:accuracy,accuracy,
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};

/** Choose a cancellation target locally; empty/unrelated ink never selects a default slot. */
export function closestDrawingSkill(strokes, skills) {
  if (!drawingBounds(strokes)) return null;
  if(recognizeBayonetChargePattern(strokes).valid)return skills.find(w=>w.id==='wakamo-bayonet'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  if(recognizeOrbitalCompassPattern(strokes).valid)return skills.find(w=>w.id==='orbital-compass'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  if(recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes).valid)return skills.find(w=>w.id==='student-handbook'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return skills.find(w=>['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(w.id)&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  let best = null, score = .25, runnerUp = 0;
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'?decagrammatonReferenceStrokes():['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?princessKeyReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'wakamo-bayonet'?bayonetChargeReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'orbital-compass'?orbitalCompassReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'water-dousing'?splashReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'student-handbook'?strictRulesReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'throwing-cards'?skilledThrowReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'molotov-cocktail'?molotovReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'luminous-nova'?luminousNovaReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);
    if (accuracy > score) { runnerUp = score === .25 ? 0 : score; score = accuracy; best = weapon; }
    else runnerUp = Math.max(runnerUp,accuracy);
  }
  return score-runnerUp >= skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin ? best : null;
}

    [[100,48],[152,100],[100,152],[48,100],[100,48]].map(([x,y])=>({x,y}))];
}

/** Vertically flipped triangle: left lower, right higher, third projecting upward between both. */

  return [box(15,90,115,190),box(95,70,195,170),box(55,10,155,110)];

/** Recognize closed, mostly horizontal/vertical frames without requiring exact reference spacing. */
export function linkedFrameEvidence(strokes) {
  const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);let frames=0,total=0,aligned=0;const frameBounds=[];
  for(const stroke of normalized) {
    if(stroke.length<4)continue;
    const bounds=drawingBounds([stroke]);if(!bounds)continue;
    const width=bounds.right-bounds.left,height=bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
    let length=0,axis=0;
    for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++) {
      const dx=Math.abs(stroke[i].x-stroke[i-1].x),dy=Math.abs(stroke[i].y-stroke[i-1].y),distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      length+=distance;if(Math.min(dx,dy)<=Math.max(dx,dy)*.45)axis+=distance;
    }
    total+=length;aligned+=axis;
    const endGap=Math.hypot(stroke[0].x-stroke.at(-1).x,stroke[0].y-stroke.at(-1).y);
    if(width>=20&&height>=20&&endGap<Math.hypot(width,height)*.3&&axis/Math.max(1,length)>.65&&length>1.5*(width+height)){frames++;frameBounds.push(bounds);}
  }
  const interlocked=frameBounds.some((a,i)=>frameBounds.filter((b,j)=>i!==j&&
    Math.min(a.right,b.right)>Math.max(a.left,b.left)&&Math.min(a.bottom,b.bottom)>Math.max(a.top,b.top)).length>=2);
  return frames>=3&&interlocked&&total>0&&aligned/total>.65;
}

/** Reference matching is scale/stroke-order independent; QuickDraw supplies supporting shape predictions. */
export async function recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()),frames=linkedFrameEvidence(strokes);
  if(accuracy<.88&&!frames)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw three interlocking squares.'};
  const components=[];
  try{components.push({name:'linked rectangles',predictions:await recognizer?.recognize(drawingModelImage(strokes))});}catch{}
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  return {valid:true,skillId:'princess-key-ex',label:'The Princess and the Key',score:Math.max(accuracy,frames ? .8 : 0),accuracy,matchAccuracy:Math.max(accuracy,frames ? .85 : 0),
    damageMultiplier:skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy),components};
}

/** Separate enclosing ink from diamond ink before combining forgiving geometry and AI assistance. */
export async function recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  const normalized=normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes),points=[];
  for(const stroke of normalized)for(let i=1;i<stroke.length;i++) {
    const a=stroke[i-1],b=stroke[i],count=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)/3));
    for(let j=0;j<=count;j++)points.push({x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*j/count,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*j/count});
  }
  if(!points.length)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a circle with a diamond inside.'};
  const radius=p=>Math.hypot((p.x-100)/100,(p.y-100)/100);
  const outer=points.filter(p=>radius(p)>.87),inner=points.filter(p=>radius(p)<.84);
  const sectors=new Set(outer.map(p=>(Math.floor((Math.atan2(p.y-100,p.x-100)+Math.PI)/Math.PI*4)+8)%8));
  const bounds=drawingBounds([inner]);
  if(sectors.size<7||!bounds||bounds.right-bounds.left<40||bounds.bottom-bounds.top<40)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw an enclosing circle and a centered diamond.'};
  const cx=(bounds.left+bounds.right)/2,cy=(bounds.top+bounds.bottom)/2;
  const rx=(bounds.right-bounds.left)/2,ry=(bounds.bottom-bounds.top)/2;
  const error=inner.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+Math.abs(Math.abs(p.x-cx)/rx+Math.abs(p.y-cy)/ry-1),0)/inner.length;
  if(Math.abs(cx-100)>25||Math.abs(cy-100)>25||error>.23)return {valid:false,reason:'Draw a diamond outline inside the circle.'};
  const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes());
  if(accuracy<luminousNovaSkillSettings.patternMinimumAccuracy)return {valid:false,reason:'Complete the circle and diamond.'};
  const components=[];
  for(const [name,ink] of [['circle',outer],['diamond',inner]]) {
    if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
    try{components.push({name,predictions:await recognizer?.recognize(drawingModelImage([ink]))});}catch{}
  }
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  return {valid:true,skillId:'luminous-nova-aura',label:'Luminous Nova',score:accuracy,accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,components};
}

 if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
import { drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Canonical pattern matching the EX Skills reference diagram. */
export function planaReferenceStrokes() {
  return [Array.from({ length: 97 }, (_, i) => ({
    x: 100 + 86 * Math.cos(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2),
    y: 100 + 86 * Math.sin(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2)
  })), [{ x: 100, y: 94 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }],
  [{ x: 76, y: 67 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }, { x: 124, y: 67 }],
  [{ x: 75, y: 119 }, { x: 125, y: 160 }],
  [{ x: 125, y: 119 }, { x: 75, y: 160 }]];
}

/** Uniformly sample ink length, ignoring pen speed, stroke order and direction. */
function normalizedInk(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const size = Math.max(bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top, 1);
  const points = [];
  for (const stroke of strokes) for (let i = 1; i < stroke.length; i++) {
    const a = stroke[i - 1], b = stroke[i];
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / size * 180));
    for (let j = 0; j <= count; j++) points.push({
      x: (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * j / count - (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2) / size,
      y: (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * j / count - (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2) / size
    });
  }
  // Bound comparison work even for very long mouse strokes.
  const unique = [...new Map(points.map(p => [
    `${Math.round(p.x * 10000)},${Math.round(p.y * 10000)}`, p
  ])).values()].sort((a, b) => Math.round(a.x * 10000) - Math.round(b.x * 10000) ||
    Math.round(a.y * 10000) - Math.round(b.y * 10000));
  return unique.filter((_, i) => i % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unique.length / 320)) === 0);
}

/** Symmetric ink distance rewards the entire reference, including missing/extra marks. */
export function drawingAccuracy(strokes, referenceStrokes = planaReferenceStrokes()) {
  const actual = normalizedInk(strokes), reference = normalizedInk(referenceStrokes);
  if (!actual.length) return 0;
  const nearestMean = (from, to) => from.reduce((total, p) => total +
    Math.min(...to.map(q => Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y))), 0) / from.length;
  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

/** Map successful reference accuracy to minimum/typical/perfect damage anchors. */
export function skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy) {
  const s = skillCastSettings;
  const value = Number.isFinite(accuracy) ? accuracy : s.accuracyAverage;
  const low = value <= s.accuracyAverage;
  const start = low ? s.accuracyMinimum : s.accuracyAverage;
  const end = low ? s.accuracyAverage : s.accuracyPerfect;
  const from = low ? s.damageMinimum : s.damageAverage;
  const to = low ? s.damageAverage : s.damageMaximum;
  return from + (to - from) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (value - start) / (end - start)));
}

      const digit = request.adminNumbers ? recognizeAdminDigit(sketch) : null;
      const result = request.adminNumbers
        ? digit ? adminSkillResult(request.owner, digit - 1) : { valid: false, reason: 'Draw a number from 1 to 6.' }
        : await recognizeLoadoutPattern(sketch, equippedSkills(request.owner), recognizer,
          () => request.token === state.token);
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      const accepted = state.resolve(request.token, result);
      if (accepted) {
        // Read restored targeting after recognition, rather than stale drawing-mode facing.
        const angle = getCastAngle();
        setStatus(`${result.label}! Accuracy: ${Math.round(result.accuracy * 100)}% | ${result.damageMultiplier.toFixed(2)}x damage. Cooldown: ${Math.floor((result.weapon?.successCooldown??180)/60)}:00.`);
        onRecognized({ player: request.owner, weapon: result.weapon, angle,
          skillId: result.skillId, accuracy: result.accuracy, damageMultiplier: result.damageMultiplier,
          clipPredictions: result.clipPredictions, predictions: [{ label: result.label, score: result.score }], components: result.components });
      } else setStatus(`${result.reason || 'Drawing not recognized.'} No cooldown applied.`);
    } catch (error) {
      if (request.token !== state.token) return;
      state.resolve(request.token, null);
      setStatus(`Recognition unavailable: ${error.message} No cooldown applied.`);
    }
  });

  /** Restore the previous cursor-aim preference and release the drawing pointer. */
  function closeOverlay() {
    overlay.hidden = true;
    aiming.setDirectionalOverride(false);
    if (pointerId !== null && drawingCanvas.hasPointerCapture?.(pointerId)) drawingCanvas.releasePointerCapture(pointerId);

import { drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { planaSkillSettings } from './game-config.js';

const distance = (a,b) => Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);

/** Reduce pen jitter while preserving corners and line crossings. */
function simplify(points, tolerance) {
  if (points.length <= 2) return points;
  const a=points[0], b=points.at(-1), dx=b.x-a.x, dy=b.y-a.y, length=dx*dx+dy*dy;
  let maximum=0,index=0;
  for(let i=1;i<points.length-1;i++) {
    const t=length?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((points[i].x-a.x)*dx+(points[i].y-a.y)*dy)/length)):0;
    const d=Math.hypot(points[i].x-a.x-t*dx,points[i].y-a.y-t*dy);
    if(d>maximum){maximum=d;index=i;}
  }
  return maximum>tolerance
    ? [...simplify(points.slice(0,index+1),tolerance).slice(0,-1),...simplify(points.slice(index),tolerance)] : [a,b];
}

/** Clip into continuous sub-strokes; never join separate shape pieces across excluded ink. */
function splitStrokes(strokes, include) {
  const result=[];
  for(const stroke of strokes){let part=[];for(const p of stroke){
    if(include(p))part.push(p);else{if(part.length>1)result.push(part);part=[];}
  }if(part.length>1)result.push(part);}
  return result;
}

/** Find a proper interior crossing, distinguishing an X from a V or parallel lines. */
function crossing(a,b) {
  const ax=a.b.x-a.a.x,ay=a.b.y-a.a.y,bx=b.b.x-b.a.x,by=b.b.y-b.a.y;
  const determinant=ax*by-ay*bx;
  if(Math.abs(determinant)<1e-6)return null;
  const dx=b.a.x-a.a.x,dy=b.a.y-a.a.y;
  const t=(dx*by-dy*bx)/determinant,u=(dx*ay-dy*ax)/determinant;
  return t>.15&&t<.85&&u>.15&&u<.85?{x:a.a.x+t*ax,y:a.a.y+t*ay}:null;
}

/** Split and validate the ring, lower X and upper arrow, independent of stroke order. */
export function segmentPlanaPattern(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds=drawingBounds(strokes),s=planaSkillSettings;
  const fail=reason=>({valid:false,reason,parts:[]});
  if(!bounds)return fail('Draw a circle with an arrow above an X inside it.');
  const width=bounds.right-bounds.left,height=bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const diameter=Math.max(width,height),cx=(bounds.left+bounds.right)/2,cy=(bounds.top+bounds.bottom)/2;
  const radial=p=>Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(width/2),(p.y-cy)/(height/2));
  // Prefer actual curved ring strokes, so symbols drawn close to the circumference
  // retain their tips instead of being incorrectly absorbed into the circle crop.
  const circular = new Set(strokes.filter(stroke => {
    if (stroke.length < 6) return false;
    let length=0,error=0;
    for(let i=0;i<stroke.length;i++){error+=Math.abs(radial(stroke[i])-1);if(i)length+=distance(stroke[i],stroke[i-1]);}
    return length>diameter*.5 && length/Math.max(1,distance(stroke[0],stroke.at(-1)))>1.12 &&
      error/stroke.length<s.circleRadialTolerance;
  }));
  const circle=splitStrokes(circular.size?[...circular]:strokes,p=>radial(p)>=s.ringInnerRadius);
  const ring=circle.flat(),bins=new Set();let radialError=0,ringLength=0;
  for(const p of ring){bins.add((Math.floor((Math.atan2(p.y-cy,p.x-cx)+Math.PI)*8/(Math.PI*2))+8)%8);radialError+=Math.abs(radial(p)-1);}
  for(const part of circle)for(let i=1;i<part.length;i++)ringLength+=distance(part[i],part[i-1]);
  if(bins.size<7||!ring.length||radialError/ring.length>s.circleRadialTolerance||ringLength<diameter*1.9)return fail('Complete the outer circle around both symbols.');
  const inner=circular.size
    ? [...splitStrokes(strokes.filter(stroke=>!circular.has(stroke)),p=>radial(p)<1.05),
       ...splitStrokes([...circular],p=>radial(p)<s.ringInnerRadius)]
    : splitStrokes(strokes,p=>radial(p)<s.ringInnerRadius);
  const lines=[];
  for(const part of inner){const points=simplify(part,diameter*s.lineSimplifyRatio);
    for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++)if(distance(points[i-1],points[i])>diameter*.07)lines.push({a:points[i-1],b:points[i]});}
  const diagonal=line=>Math.abs(line.b.x-line.a.x)>diameter*.08&&Math.abs(line.b.y-line.a.y)>diameter*.08;
  const crosses=[];
  for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<lines.length;j++){
    const a=lines[i],b=lines[j],point=crossing(a,b);
    if(point&&point.y>cy-height*.08&&diagonal(a)&&diagonal(b)&&
      (a.b.x-a.a.x)*(a.b.y-a.a.y)*(b.b.x-b.a.x)*(b.b.y-b.a.y)<0)crosses.push({point,lines:[a,b]});
  }
  const tolerance=diameter*s.joinToleranceRatio;
  for(const cross of crosses)for(let i=0;i<lines.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<lines.length;j++){
    const a=lines[i],b=lines[j];
    for(const tipA of [a.a,a.b])for(const tipB of [b.a,b.b]){
      if(distance(tipA,tipB)>tolerance)continue;
      const tip={x:(tipA.x+tipB.x)/2,y:(tipA.y+tipB.y)/2};
      const armA=tipA===a.a?a.b:a.a,armB=tipB===b.a?b.b:b.a;
      if(tip.y>=cross.point.y-height*.1)continue;
      const shaft=lines.find(line=>{
        if(line===a||line===b)return false;
        const near=distance(line.a,tip)<distance(line.b,tip)?line.a:line.b;
        const end=near===line.a?line.b:line.a;
        const dx=end.x-tip.x,dy=end.y-tip.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
        if(distance(near,tip)>tolerance||length<diameter*.14)return false;
        const ux=dx/length,uy=dy/length;
        const av={x:armA.x-tip.x,y:armA.y-tip.y},bv={x:armB.x-tip.x,y:armB.y-tip.y};
        const sideA=ux*av.y-uy*av.x,sideB=ux*bv.y-uy*bv.x;
        return av.x*ux+av.y*uy>diameter*.035&&bv.x*ux+bv.y*uy>diameter*.035&&
          sideA*sideB<0&&Math.min(Math.abs(sideA),Math.abs(sideB))>diameter*.035;
      });
      if(!shaft)continue;
      const arrow=[a,b,shaft];
      if(Math.max(...arrow.flatMap(line=>[line.a.y,line.b.y]))>=cross.point.y)continue;
      return {valid:true,score:Math.max(.7,1-radialError/ring.length),parts:[
        {name:'circle',strokes:circle},{name:'x',strokes:cross.lines.map(line=>[line.a,line.b])},
        {name:'arrow',strokes:arrow.map(line=>[line.a,line.b])}]};
    }
  }
  return fail(crosses.length?'Draw an arrow above the X, inside the circle.':'Draw two crossing diagonal lines for the X below the arrow.');
}

});}

import {playerSettings,wakamoBayonetSettings,wakamoBayonetLevelStats} from './game-config.js';
import {totalWeaponDamage,rollAttackDamage,statMultiplier} from './combat-stats.js';
import {getAllEnemies,getEnemy,damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
import {getCombatHitbox,getEnemyHurtbox,segmentHitsBody} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import {beginKnockback} from './knockback.js';

export function createBayonetCharge({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,state=null,ghosts=[];
 function reset(){if(owner)delete owner.bayonetChargeActive;owner=null;state=null;ghosts=[];}
 function cast(player,angle=0){const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='wakamo-bayonet');if(!weapon)return false;reset();owner=player;state={angle,windup:.25,remaining:5,hits:new Set(),ghostTime:0};player.bayonetChargeActive=true;return true;}
 function update(delta,player,move){
  if(owner&&owner!==player){reset();return false;}
  for(const ghost of ghosts)ghost.age+=delta;ghosts=ghosts.filter(g=>g.age<.35);
  if(!state)return false;
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='wakamo-bayonet');if(!weapon){reset();return false;}
  let left=Math.max(0,delta);
  while(state&&left>1e-8){const windup=state.windup>1e-8,dt=Math.min(left,1/120,windup?state.windup:state.remaining);left-=dt;
   const before=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
   const speed=windup?80:3*playerSettings.movementBase*(player.movementSpeedMultiplier||1)*statMultiplier(player,'spdPercent');
   const blocked=move(state.angle+(windup?Math.PI:0),speed,dt);
   if(windup){state.windup=Math.max(0,state.windup-dt);continue;}
   const after=getCombatHitbox(player,false);state.remaining-=dt;state.ghostTime+=dt;
   if(state.ghostTime>=.035){state.ghostTime%=.035;if(player.lastPose)ghosts.push({x:player.x,y:player.y,pose:player.lastPose,image:player.image,age:0});}
   for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){
    if(!(enemy.hp>0)||state.hits.has(enemy.id))continue;
    const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),rx=Math.max(before.rx,after.rx),ry=Math.max(before.ry,after.ry);
    if(!segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+rx,ry:body.ry+ry},before.x,before.y,after.x,after.y))continue;
    const stats=wakamoBayonetLevelStats(weapon.level),base=totalWeaponDamage(player,'wakamo-bayonet',wakamoBayonetSettings.damage,stats.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:stats.count,hitCooldownFrames:wakamoBayonetSettings.hitCooldown*60});
    const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,base,random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'wakamo-bayonet',damageMod:10,skillAttack:true});
    state.hits.add(enemy.id);
    if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'wakamo-bayonet',skillAttack:true})===false)continue;

    if (activeCharacter.transition) activeCharacter.transition.elapsed += delta * 1000;

      activeCharacter.attack=null;activeCharacter.chargeMotion={angle,speed};
      const names=['up','upRight','right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft'];

    });

import {playerSettings,wakamoBayonetSettings,wakamoBayonetLevelStats} from './game-config.js';
import {totalWeaponDamage,rollAttackDamage,statMultiplier} from './combat-stats.js';
import {getAllEnemies,getEnemy,damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
import {getCombatHitbox,getEnemyHurtbox,segmentHitsBody} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import {beginKnockback} from './knockback.js';

export function createBayonetCharge({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,state=null,ghosts=[];
 function reset(){if(owner)delete owner.bayonetChargeActive;owner=null;state=null;ghosts=[];}
 function cast(player,angle=0){const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='wakamo-bayonet');if(!weapon)return false;reset();owner=player;state={angle,windup:.25,remaining:5,hits:new Set(),ghostTime:0};player.bayonetChargeActive=true;return true;}
 function cancelByMovement(player,direction){
  if(!state||owner!==player||state.windup>1e-8||!direction)return false;
  const [x,y]=direction,length=Math.hypot(x,y);if(!length)return false;
  if((x*Math.cos(state.angle)+y*Math.sin(state.angle))/length>-.5)return false;
  delete player.bayonetChargeActive;state=null;return true;
 }
 function update(delta,player,move){
  if(owner&&owner!==player){reset();return false;}
  for(const ghost of ghosts)ghost.age+=delta;ghosts=ghosts.filter(g=>g.age<.35);
  if(!state)return false;
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='wakamo-bayonet');if(!weapon){reset();return false;}
  let left=Math.max(0,delta);
  while(state&&left>1e-8){const windup=state.windup>1e-8,dt=Math.min(left,1/120,windup?state.windup:state.remaining);left-=dt;
   const before=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
   const speed=windup?80:3*playerSettings.movementBase*(player.movementSpeedMultiplier||1)*statMultiplier(player,'spdPercent');
   const blocked=move(state.angle+(windup?Math.PI:0),speed,dt,state.angle);
   if(windup){state.windup=Math.max(0,state.windup-dt);continue;}
   const after=getCombatHitbox(player,false);state.remaining-=dt;state.ghostTime+=dt;
   if(state.ghostTime>=.035){state.ghostTime%=.035;if(player.lastPose)ghosts.push({x:player.x,y:player.y,pose:player.lastPose,image:player.image,age:0});}
   for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){
    if(!(enemy.hp>0)||state.hits.has(enemy.id))continue;
    const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),rx=Math.max(before.rx,after.rx),ry=Math.max(before.ry,after.ry);
    if(!segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+rx,ry:body.ry+ry},before.x,before.y,after.x,after.y))continue;
    const stats=wakamoBayonetLevelStats(weapon.level),base=totalWeaponDamage(player,'wakamo-bayonet',wakamoBayonetSettings.damage,stats.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:stats.count,hitCooldownFrames:wakamoBayonetSettings.hitCooldown*60});
    const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,base,random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'wakamo-bayonet',damageMod:10,skillAttack:true});
    state.hits.add(enemy.id);
    if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'wakamo-bayonet',skillAttack:true})===false)continue;
    if(getEnemy(enemy.id)){
     enemy.stunRemaining=Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining||0,5);
     const side=(body.x-after.x)*-Math.sin(state.angle)+(body.y-after.y)*Math.cos(state.angle)>=0?1:-1;
     enemy.skillKnockback=beginKnockback(enemy,-Math.sin(state.angle)*side*90,Math.cos(state.angle)*side*90,.25);
    }
   }
 const move=vm.runInContext('('+callback+')',context);move(Math.PI,80,.25,0);assert.equal(context.activeCharacter.direction,'right');assert.equal(context.activeCharacter.facing,'right');assert(Math.abs(context.activeCharacter.x+20)<1e-8);move(0,720,.1,0);assert.equal(context.activeCharacter.facing,'right');move(0,80,.25,Math.PI);assert.equal(context.activeCharacter.facing,'left');
}

export function createBayonetCharge({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,state=null,ghosts=[];
 function reset(){if(owner)delete owner.bayonetChargeActive;owner=null;state=null;ghosts=[];}

 function setMovementInput(player,direction){
  if(!state||owner!==player)return;
  const [x,y]=direction||[0,0],length=Math.hypot(x,y);
  const braking=length>0&&(x*Math.cos(state.angle)+y*Math.sin(state.angle))/length<=-.5;
  if(braking&&!state.braking){state.brakeHeld=0;state.brakeStartScale=state.speedScale;}
  if(!braking)state.brakeHeld=0;
  state.braking=braking;

import {tuningPerk,slowdownTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
/** Temporary movement reduction, independent of permanent speed and knockback. */
export function applySlowdown(enemy,percent,seconds=5){
  if(enemy.hp<=0||!(percent>0)||!(seconds>0))return false;
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0,seconds);
  enemy.slowdownPercent=percent;return true;
}
export function updateSlowdown(enemy,delta){
  enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  enemy.flattenedRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.flattenedRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  enemy.splashSlowRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.splashSlowRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(enemy.splashSlowRemaining<1e-6){enemy.splashSlowRemaining=0;enemy.splashSlowPercent=0;}
  const dt=Math.max(0,delta),delay=enemy.waterRootDelay||0;
  enemy.waterRootDelay=Math.max(0,delay-dt);
  enemy.waterRootRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.waterRootRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,dt-delay));
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(enemy.slowdownRemaining<1e-6){enemy.slowdownRemaining=0;enemy.slowdownPercent=0;}
}
export function slowdownMultiplier(enemy){if(enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining>0||enemy.flattenedRemaining>0||enemy.waterRootDelay>0||enemy.waterRootRemaining>0)return 0;return Math.min(enemy.slowdownRemaining>0?1-Math.min(100,Math.max(0,enemy.slowdownPercent||0))/100:1,enemy.splashSlowRemaining>0?1-Math.min(100,Math.max(0,enemy.splashSlowPercent||0))/100:1);}

/** Single bonus hit; does not recursively trigger itself or repeatedly tick. */
export function trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage,random=Math.random}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(main!=='plana-umbrella'||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0)return false;
  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowChance');if(!chance||random()>=chance)return false;
  if(!applySlowdown(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowPercent'),slowdownTuningSettings.seconds))return false;
  const hit=rollDamage(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowDamagePercent')/100);
  damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{slowdownTuning:true});return true;
}

import { combatBalance } from './game-config.js';
import { normalSpriteSize, spriteDisplayPadding } from './scene-metrics.js';

// EDIT half-width, half-height and center offset as fractions of display size.
// Ellipses exclude transparent corners while covering more of the visible body.
export const combatHitboxes = {
  plana: { rx: 0.27, ry: 0.38, y: 0.03, playerOffsetY: 6, playerRadiusScale: 0.72 }, // Pixels downward for the controlled player.
  arona: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.39, y: 0.03 },
  // Small foot-level ellipse: tune rx/ry for size; feet keeps it at the sprite baseline.
  midori: { rx: 0.13, ry: 0.075, radiusSize: normalSpriteSize, feet: true },
  yuuka: { rx: 0.25, ry: 0.42, y: 0.02 },
  mob: { rx: 0.28, ry: 0.28, y: 0.04, eliteOffsetY: 6, normalOffsetY: 6 }, // Circular Mob collider; elite variants scale the same profile.
  iroha: { rx: 0.44, ry: 0.29, y: 0.06 },
  shiroko: { rx: 0.30, ry: 0.30, y: 0.05 } // Center on the visible body below the halo.
};

/** Return a stable body ellipse, scaling automatically for elite/boss sizes. */
export function getCombatHitbox(character, enemy = Boolean(character.id)) {
  const name = (character.type || character.label || 'mob').toLowerCase();
  const key = Object.keys(combatHitboxes).find(type => name.includes(type)) || 'mob';
  const profile = character.combatHitbox || combatHitboxes[key];
  const size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const hitboxScale = enemy ? combatBalance.enemyHitboxScale : 1;
  const radiusSize = profile.radiusSize || size;
  const rx = radiusSize * profile.rx * hitboxScale * (enemy ? 1 : profile.playerRadiusScale || 1);
  // Compress player height to the existing half-width, producing a centered circle.
  const ry = enemy ? radiusSize * profile.ry * hitboxScale : rx;
  // Foot-anchored profiles retain their small dimensions when the artwork grows.
  const offsetY = !enemy ? (profile.playerOffsetY || 0) : profile.feet ? size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding - ry : size * profile.y;
  const eliteOffsetY = enemy ? (character.elite ? profile.eliteOffsetY || 0 : profile.normalOffsetY || 0) : 0;
  return { x: character.x, y: character.y + offsetY + eliteOffsetY, rx, ry };
}

}
export function getSlowTintOpacity(character){
 if(character.death||character.hp===0||character.isPlayerVisual)return 0;

  // X is an unbounded world position, not a canvas position. Never wrap it:
  // future enemy positions must remain stable when background tiles disappear.
  if (maps[currentMap].axis === 'horizontal') {
    character.y = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousY, character.y, bounds.top + margin, bounds.bottom - margin);
  } else {
    character.x = constrainWithoutTeleport(previousX, character.x, bounds.left + margin, bounds.right - margin);
  }
}

/** Sweep to contact, then project remaining motion onto the actual angled edge. */
export function resolveIslandMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, map, ignoreObstacles = false) {
  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.max(Math.abs(toX - fromX), Math.abs(toY - fromY)) / 6));
  const dx = (toX - fromX) / steps, dy = (toY - fromY) / steps;
  let x = fromX, y = fromY;
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    if (canStandOnIsland(character, x + dx, y + dy, map, ignoreObstacles)) {
      x += dx; y += dy;
      continue;
    }
    // Reach the edge without crossing it; keep the unapplied movement for sliding.
    let low = 0, high = 1;
    for (let iteration = 0; iteration < 10; iteration++) {
      const fraction = (low + high) / 2;
      if (canStandOnIsland(character, x + dx * fraction, y + dy * fraction, map, ignoreObstacles)) low = fraction;
      else high = fraction;
    }

// Map zoom is configured independently of actors in game-config.js.


/** Physical playable limits for the enlarged horizontal/vertical strip maps. */
export function stripMapBounds(map, width, height, topPadding = 0, bottomPadding = 0) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') return {
    left: -Infinity, right: Infinity,
    top: map.originY + topPadding + officeWindowInsetSource * height * mapSizeMultiplier / 1086,
    bottom: map.originY + height * mapSizeMultiplier - bottomPadding
  };
  if (map.axis !== 'vertical') return { left: -Infinity, right: Infinity, top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity };
  return {
    left: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.leftWallRatio || 0),
    right: map.originX + width * mapSizeMultiplier * (map.rightWallRatio ?? 1),
    top: -Infinity, bottom: Infinity
  };
}

/** Stop the camera at finite edges while leaving the long map axis infinite. */
export function clampStripCamera(map, camera, width, height) {
  if (map.axis === 'horizontal') camera.y = Math.max(map.originY,
    Math.min(map.originY + height * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.y));
  if (map.axis === 'vertical') camera.x = Math.max(map.originX,
    Math.min(map.originX + width * (mapSizeMultiplier - 1), camera.x));
}

/** Keep enlarged enemy spawns inside physical walls, independent of the camera. */
export function canSpawnInStrip(character, x, y, bounds, defaultSize = 112) {
  const margin = (character.spriteSize || defaultSize) / 2;
  return x >= bounds.left + margin && x <= bounds.right - margin &&
    y >= bounds.top + margin && y <= bounds.bottom - margin;
}

/** Render only visible columns; horizontal position alone determines their layout. */
export function drawOfficeWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(height);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.x - map.originX - overlap) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.x + width - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  for (let column = first; column <= last; column++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride - camera.x);
    const right = Math.round(map.originX + column * metrics.stride + metrics.width - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[officeTileIndex(column)].image, x, y, right - x, Math.round(metrics.height));
  }
}

/** Draw letters and halo over actors behind the monument, without blocking movement. */
export function drawOfficeMonumentOcclusion(context, character, map, camera, height, opacity = 1) {
  const metrics = officeMetrics(height), size = character.spriteSize || normalSpriteSize;
  const footY = character.y + size / 2 - spriteDisplayPadding;
  if (footY >= map.originY + officeObstacleBoxes[8][0][3] * metrics.scale) return;
  const first = Math.floor((character.x - size - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((character.x + size - map.originX) / metrics.stride);
  return resolveObstacleMotion(character, fromX, fromY, toX, toY,
    (...region) => palaceObstaclesIn(map, width, ...region));
}

/** Render only rows that intersect the camera, without allocating tile objects. */
export function drawPalaceWorld(context, map, camera, width, height) {
  const metrics = palaceMetrics(width);
  const first = Math.floor((camera.y - map.originY - 2) / metrics.stride);
  const last = Math.floor((camera.y + height - map.originY) / metrics.stride);
  for (let row = first; row <= last; row++) {
    const x = Math.round(map.originX - camera.x);
    const y = Math.round(map.originY + row * metrics.stride - camera.y);
    const bottom = Math.round(map.originY + row * metrics.stride + metrics.height - camera.y);
    context.drawImage(map.tiles[palaceTileIndex(row)].image, x, y, Math.round(metrics.width), bottom - y);
  }
}

/** Keep an entire ground-loot footprint on paving and outside obstacle polygons. */
export function canPlaceIslandLoot(x, y, radius, map) {
  const sx = (x - map.originX) / islandScale, sy = (y - map.originY) / islandScale;
  const r = radius / islandScale;
  return [[sx-r,sy-r],[sx+r,sy-r],[sx+r,sy+r],[sx-r,sy+r]].every(([px,py]) => insideShore(px,py)) &&
    !islandObstacles.some(polygon => intersectsBox(polygon, sx-r, sy-r, sx+r, sy+r));
}

/** Validate island containment and all obstacle footprints at an actor location. */
export function canStandOnIsland(character,x,y,map,ignoreObstacles=false) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const sx=(x-map.originX)/islandScale;
  const sy=(y+size/2-spriteDisplayPadding-map.originY)/islandScale;
  const rx=size*.12/islandScale, ry=size*.05/islandScale;
  const corners=[[sx-rx,sy-ry],[sx+rx,sy-ry],[sx+rx,sy+ry],[sx-rx,sy+ry]];
  return corners.every(([x,y])=>insideShore(x,y)) &&
    (ignoreObstacles || !islandObstacles.some(p=>intersectsBox(p,sx-rx,sy-ry,sx+rx,sy+ry)));
}

  /** Share the exact arrow angle with attacks, including cursor aiming. */
  function getAngle(character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    const x = character.x - cameraX;
    const y = character.y - cameraY;
    let dx = vector[0];
    let dy = vector[1];
    if (state.cursorAim && !state.directionalOverride) {
      dx = state.pointer.x - x;
      dy = state.pointer.y - y;
      // Preserve facing if the cursor is precisely on the character anchor.
      if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) [dx, dy] = vector;
    }
    return Math.atan2(dy, dx)+(character.sportsDrinkAimOffset||0);
  }

  /** Draw an upward-native arrow rotated toward facing or the custom cursor. */
  function draw(context, character, cameraX, vector, cameraY = 0) {
    if (!arrow || !crosshair) return;

      context.save();

import {playerSettings,normalSpriteSize,spriteDisplayPadding} from './game-config.js';
import {statMultiplier} from './combat-stats.js';

import {getEnemyHurtbox,segmentHitsBody} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import {createEnemySpatialIndex} from './enemy-spatial-index.js';

export function ridingWaveOrigin(player){return {x:player.x,y:player.y+(player.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize)/2-spriteDisplayPadding};}
export function createRidingWaves(){
 let owner=null,state=null,board=null;
 const ready=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{board=new Image();board.onload=resolve;board.onerror=()=>{board=null;resolve();};board.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/Event 46 - Surfboard.png',import.meta.url).href;});

 function setMovementInput(player,direction){if(!state||owner!==player)return;const [x,y]=direction||[0,0],length=Math.hypot(x,y),braking=length>0&&(x*Math.cos(state.angle)+y*Math.sin(state.angle))/length<=-.5;if(braking&&!state.braking){state.brakeHeld=0;state.brakeStartScale=state.speedScale;}if(!braking)state.brakeHeld=0;state.braking=braking;if(length>0&&!braking)state.targetAngle=Math.atan2(y,x);}
 function setAimAngle(player,angle){if(state&&owner===player&&Number.isFinite(angle))state.targetAngle=angle;}
 function update(delta,player,move){
  if(!state)return false;if(owner!==player||!player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='time-to-surf')){reset();return false;}
  let left=Math.max(0,delta),index=null;
  while(state&&left>1e-8){const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,state.remaining);left-=dt;const before=ridingWaveOrigin(player),previousScale=state.speedScale;
   if(!state.braking){const difference=Math.atan2(Math.sin(state.targetAngle-state.angle),Math.cos(state.targetAngle-state.angle));state.angle+=Math.max(-3*dt,Math.min(3*dt,difference));}
   if(Math.abs(Math.cos(state.angle))>.1)state.visualFacing=Math.cos(state.angle)<0?'left':'right';
   if(state.braking){state.brakeHeld=Math.min(2,state.brakeHeld+dt);state.speedScale=state.brakeStartScale*(1-state.brakeHeld/2);}else state.speedScale=Math.min(1,state.speedScale+dt);
   const speed=1.5*playerSettings.movementBase*(player.movementSpeedMultiplier||1)*statMultiplier(player,'spdPercent')*(previousScale+state.speedScale)/2;
   move(state.angle,speed,dt,state.visualFacing==='left'?Math.PI:0);const after=ridingWaveOrigin(player);state.remaining-=dt;state.age+=dt;
   const c=Math.cos(state.angle),s=Math.sin(state.angle),radius=Math.max(state.width,state.depth)/2;
   for(const enemy of (index??=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox)).querySegment(before,after,radius)){

    const body={shape:'ellipse',x:0,y:0,rx:state.depth/2+Math.hypot(b.rx*c,b.ry*s),ry:state.width/2+Math.hypot(b.rx*s,b.ry*c)};
    if(!segmentHitsBody(body,a.x,a.y,z.x,z.y))continue;state.hits.add(enemy.id);enemy.flattenedRemaining=Math.max(enemy.flattenedRemaining||0,2);enemy.ridingWaveSlowRemaining=Math.max(enemy.ridingWaveSlowRemaining||0,6);
   }
   if(state.remaining<=1e-8||state.brakeHeld>=2-1e-8){delete player.ridingWavesActive;state=null;}
  }return true;

  const gradient=context.createLinearGradient(0,-d/2,0,d/2);gradient.addColorStop(0,'rgba(224,255,255,.95)');gradient.addColorStop(.25,'rgba(72,214,255,.85)');gradient.addColorStop(.7,'rgba(35,148,235,.6)');gradient.addColorStop(1,'rgba(42,140,231,0)');context.fillStyle=gradient;context.beginPath();context.ellipse(0,0,w/2,d/2,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();

  if(board?.complete&&board.naturalWidth){const width=state.height*1.25,height=width*192/605;context.save();context.translate(p.x-camera.x,p.y-camera.y-2);context.globalAlpha=fade;context.rotate(state.visualFacing==='right'?-Math.PI/18:Math.PI/18);if(state.visualFacing==='right')context.scale(-1,1);context.drawImage(board,17,62,605,192,-width/2,-height/2,width,height);context.restore();}

import {weakenedAttackMultiplier} from './weak-tuning.js';
import { enemyContactDamageFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { yuukaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
export { contactSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { damagePlayer } from './player-stats.js';
import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

// Contact reaction settings live in game-config.js.
/** Detect player pass-through with a swept segment rather than endpoint overlap only. */
function contactGeometry(npc, player, motion) {
  const enemyBody = getCombatHitbox(npc, true), playerBody = getCombatHitbox(player, false);
  const rx = enemyBody.rx + playerBody.rx, ry = enemyBody.ry + playerBody.ry;
  const fromX = playerBody.x - motion.x, fromY = playerBody.y - motion.y;
  const lengthSquared = motion.x * motion.x + motion.y * motion.y;
  const scaledLength = (motion.x / rx) ** 2 + (motion.y / ry) ** 2;
  const t = scaledLength ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1,
    ((enemyBody.x - fromX) * motion.x / rx ** 2 +
      (enemyBody.y - fromY) * motion.y / ry ** 2) / scaledLength)) : 1;
  const dx = enemyBody.x - (fromX + motion.x * t);
  const dy = enemyBody.y - (fromY + motion.y * t);
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const pushing = lengthSquared > 0.0001 &&
    motion.x * (npc.x - fromX) + motion.y * (npc.y - fromY) > 0;
  // At exact overlap, push along player travel; otherwise away from the player.
  const fallbackLength = Math.hypot(motion.x, motion.y) || 1;
  const nx = distance > 0.001 ? dx / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.x / fallbackLength : 1;
  const ny = distance > 0.001 ? dy / distance : lengthSquared ? motion.y / fallbackLength : 0;
  const radius = 1 / Math.hypot(nx / rx, ny / ry);
  return { touching: (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2 < 1, pushing, radius, nx, ny,
    overlap: Math.max(0, radius - Math.hypot(enemyBody.x - playerBody.x, enemyBody.y - playerBody.y)) };
}

/** React to contact, flash once, and pause chase until bounce/push recovery ends. */
export function updateNpcContact(npc, player, motion, delta, move, survivalSeconds = 0) {
  if(npc.frozenRemaining>0)return false;
  npc.contactCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.contactCooldown || 0) - delta);
  // Per-enemy attack cooldown is separate from recoil and the player's global I-frames.
  npc.playerHitCooldown = Math.max(0, (npc.playerHitCooldown || 0) - delta);
  const hit = contactGeometry(npc, player, motion);
  if (hit.touching && !(player.contactIFrames > 0) && !(npc.playerHitCooldown > 0)) {
    const baseDamage = npc.contactDamage ?? (npc.type === 'mob' ? contactSettings.mobDamage : contactSettings.playerDamage);
    const damage = npc.perTypeStats ? Math.floor(baseDamage * (npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1)) :
      enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, player.level || 1, survivalSeconds, npc.contactDamageMultiplier ?? 1);
    const damaged = damagePlayer(player, npc.weakRemaining>0?Math.floor(damage*weakenedAttackMultiplier(npc)):damage);
    if (damaged && npc.type === 'yuuka') npc.playerHitCooldown = yuukaSettings.contactHitInterval;
    if (damaged) {player.contactIFrames = contactSettings.iFrameDuration;npc.secondsSincePlayerHit=0;}
  }
  const overrideBounce = npc.contactReaction?.kind === 'bounce' && hit.pushing;
  if (hit.touching && ((!npc.contactReaction && !npc.contactCooldown) || overrideBounce)) {
    const kind = hit.pushing ? 'push' : 'bounce';
    const settings = contactSettings[kind];
    const overlap = hit.overlap;
    const knockback = beginKnockback(npc, hit.nx * (settings.distance + overlap),
      hit.ny * (settings.distance + overlap), settings.travel);
    npc.contactReaction = knockback ? { ...knockback, kind, nx: hit.nx, ny: hit.ny } : null;
    if (!knockback) npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
    npc.attack = null;
  }
  const reaction = npc.contactReaction;
  if (!reaction) return false;
  const settings = contactSettings[reaction.kind];
  advanceKnockback(npc, reaction, delta, move);
  const pauseChase = npc.contactRecoveryDelay !== false;
  if (pauseChase) npc.moving = false;
  const recovery = pauseChase ? settings.recovery : settings.travel;
  if (reaction.elapsed >= recovery) {
    npc.contactReaction = null;
    npc.contactCooldown = contactSettings.cooldown;
  }
  // Bosses still recoil/flash, but do not skip their AI update or wait afterward.
  return pauseChase;
}

/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount, {projectile=false,enemyHit=true}={}) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if(character.bayonetChargeActive||character.supportState?.invulnerableRemaining>0||(projectile&&character.supportState?.shieldRemaining>0)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};return false;}
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula([].concat(character.damageReductionPercent??[],lifeJacketStats(character)?.reduction??0)));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};showDamageNumber(character,0,true,'miss');return false;}
  const initialFraction=chiseDelayConfigured()?chiseImmediateFraction(character):1;
  const immediate=Math.round(damage*initialFraction),deferred=damage-immediate;
  if(deferred>0){
    if(!(character.chisePendingDamage>0))character.chiseTickElapsed=0;
    character.chisePendingDamage=(character.chisePendingDamage||0)+deferred;
  }
  const taken=applyResolvedPlayerDamage(character,immediate);
  character.lastDamageResult.deferredDamage=deferred;
  if(enemyHit&&character.lastDamageResult.healthDamage>0&&character.sportsDrinkState)character.sportsDrinkState.crit*=.5;
  return taken||deferred>0;
}

/** Reflect inside the visible screen; the complete ball stays inside its edges. */
export function serveBounce(position,velocity,min,max){
 if(max<=min)return {position:(min+max)/2,velocity:0};
 while(position<min||position>max){if(position<min){position=2*min-position;velocity=Math.abs(velocity);}if(position>max){position=2*max-position;velocity=-Math.abs(velocity);}}
 return {position,velocity};
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target, weaponId, skillAttack = false } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus + sportsDrinkCritBonus(character) - itemCritPenalty(character) + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critChancePercent'))) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critDamagePercent')) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula([].concat(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent??[],target?.weakRemaining>0?target.weakDefensePercent:0)),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,itemDamageBonus(character),...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
    attackModifier: damageMod*(skillAttack?itemSkillDamageMultiplier(character):1) // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.
  });
  return { damage: attackDamageFormula(totalWeaponDamage, totalCharacterATK(character), combinedModifier, random),
    critical, type: critical ? (characterCriticalMultiplier(character)>=2?'orangecritical':'critical') : 'normal' };
}

export const damageFlashDuration = 240; // EDIT total pulse length in milliseconds.
const riseDuration = 45; // Fast gradual rise, followed by a longer fade out.
const whiteSprites = new WeakMap();

/** Return a smooth white-tint intensity, never a full-screen or rectangular flash. */
export function getDamageFlashOpacity(character) {
  const elapsed = character.damageFlashElapsed;
  if (elapsed === undefined || elapsed < 0 || elapsed >= damageFlashDuration) return 0;
  const progress = elapsed < riseDuration
    ? elapsed / riseDuration
    : 1 - (elapsed - riseDuration) / (damageFlashDuration - riseDuration);
  const smooth = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
  return smooth * 0.85;
}

/** Advance visual feedback independently of whether movement AI is paused. */
export function advanceDamageFlash(character, delta) {
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed === undefined) return;
  character.damageFlashElapsed += delta * 1000;
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed >= damageFlashDuration) {
    delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
  }
}

/** Cache a white silhouette retaining the original image's transparent pixels. */
export function getWhiteSprite(image) {
  if (!whiteSprites.has(image)) {
    const surface = document.createElement('canvas');
    surface.width = image.naturalWidth;
    surface.height = image.naturalHeight;
    const context = surface.getContext('2d');
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, surface.width, surface.height);
    whiteSprites.set(image, surface);
  }
  return whiteSprites.get(image);
}

const slowedSprites=new WeakMap();
/** Slow overlays tint opaque sprite pixels only; cached per sheet or decoded GIF frame. */
export function getSlowedSprite(image){
 if(!slowedSprites.has(image)){
  const surface=document.createElement('canvas');surface.width=image.naturalWidth;surface.height=image.naturalHeight;
  const context=surface.getContext('2d');context.drawImage(image,0,0);context.globalCompositeOperation='source-in';context.fillStyle='#173c86';context.fillRect(0,0,surface.width,surface.height);slowedSprites.set(image,surface);
 }
 return slowedSprites.get(image);
}
export function getSlowTintOpacity(character){
 if(character.death||character.hp===0||character.isPlayerVisual)return 0;
 return (character.ridingWaveSlowRemaining>0||(character.splashSlowRemaining>0&&character.splashSlowPercent>0)||(character.slowdownRemaining>0&&character.slowdownPercent>0)) ? .48 : 0;
}

  const variance = base > damageRules.randomizeAbove
    ? Math.max(base * damageRules.variancePercent, damageRules.minimumVariance) : 0;
  const randomized = variance ? base - variance + random() * variance * 2 : base;
  return Math.max(0, Math.round(randomized * Math.max(0, damageMod)));

/** Crowd-adjusted arrivals: 8/s empty -> 5/s at40 nearby; 2/s at50 visible slots. */
export function spawnRateFormula(nearby, visible) {
  const s = playtestSpawnSettings;
  if (visible >= s.visibleLimit) return s.crowdedPerSecond;
  return Math.round(s.perSecond + (s.maxPerSecond - s.perSecond) *
    (1 - Math.min(1, nearby / s.nearbyTarget)));
}
 */
export function weaponDamageFormula(baseWeaponDamage, bonusesPercent = [], {
  growthRank = 0, playerLevel = 1, growthEligible = false,
  projectileCount = 1, hitCooldownFrames = 60, enhancementRank = 0
} = {}) {
  const weapon = baseWeaponDamage * bonusesPercent.reduce((value, bonus) => value * (1 + bonus / 100), 1);
  const rank = Math.max(0, Math.min(growthSettings.maxRank, Math.floor(growthRank)));
  const tickMultiplier = Math.min(1, Math.max(growthSettings.minimumTickMultiplier,
    hitCooldownFrames / growthSettings.tickThresholdFrames));
  const growth = growthEligible ? growthSettings.damagePerLevelPerRank / damageRules.baseScale *
    rank * Math.max(1, playerLevel) / Math.max(1, projectileCount) * tickMultiplier : 0;
  // Enhancements add flat damage after level/enchantment bonuses, split over primary projectiles.
  const enhancement=Math.max(0,Math.floor(enhancementRank))*crafterSettings.enhancementDamagePerRank/damageRules.baseScale/Math.max(1,projectileCount);
  return weapon + growth + enhancement;
}
export function totalWeaponDamage(character, weaponId, base, bonusesPercent = [], options = {}) {
  const mainWeaponId = character.mainWeaponId ?? (character.label === 'Plana' ? 'plana-umbrella' : null);
  const weapon=character.attackSlots?.find(item=>item?.id===weaponId);
  const soloBonus=character.tuningParts&&options.soloTuningEligible!==false&&weapon?.soloTuningEligible!==false?startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'soloDamagePerEmptyPercent')*emptyWeaponSlotCount(character):0;
  return weaponDamageFormula(base, [...bonusesPercent,startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'damagePercent'),-startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'weaponDamagePenaltyPercent'),soloBonus,character.tuningParts&&stationaryTuningActive(character)?startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'stationaryDamagePercent'):0,character.tuningParts?weaponTuningDamageBonus(character,weaponId):0], {
    ...options, projectileCount:character.tuningParts?startingWeaponProjectileCount(character,weaponId,options.projectileCount??weapon?.attackCount??1):(options.projectileCount??weapon?.attackCount??1), enhancementRank:weapon?.enhancementRank ?? 0, growthEligible: weaponId === mainWeaponId,
    growthRank: options.growthEligible===false?0:(character.growthRank ?? growthSettings.defaultRank), playerLevel: character.level ?? 1
  });
}

import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale, startingWeaponProjectileCount } from './tuning-parts.js';

/** One-hit missiles choose random visible targets, then retain their launch trajectory. */
export function createSaintPredatorAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,missiles=[],shots=0;
 const s=saintPredatorSettings;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;missiles=[];shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,viewport){

   const angle=t?Math.atan2(t.y-body.y,t.x-body.x):random()*Math.PI*2,dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);

   missiles.push({x:body.x+dx*edge,y:body.y+dy*edge,angle,age:0,size,speed:stats.speed,count,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses});shots++;

function holyMissileEvidence(strokes){

 if(!normalized.some(s=>{const b=drawingBounds([s]);return b&&b.bottom-b.top>150&&Math.hypot(s[0].x-s.at(-1).x,s[0].y-s.at(-1).y)<55;}))return false;

import { moustacheMedalSettings, moustacheMedalLevelStats, flatCharacterWeaponBonus, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { beginKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Movement-facing rear/side directions never aim a wall forward, including diagonal movement. */
export function moustacheMedalAngles(direction=[0,1],level=1){const facing=Math.atan2(direction[1],direction[0]),rear=facing+Math.PI;return level>=7?[rear,rear-Math.PI/2,rear+Math.PI/2]:[rear];}
export function createMoustacheMedalAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=moustacheMedalSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,walls=[],shots=0;
 const ready=Promise.resolve();
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;walls=[];shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,direction){
  const stats=moustacheMedalLevelStats(weapon.level,flatCharacterWeaponBonus(player)>1),center=getCombatHitbox(player,false),area=stats.size*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
  const angles=moustacheMedalAngles(direction,weapon.level);
  for(const angle of angles){walls.push({x:center.x,y:center.y,fromX:center.x,fromY:center.y,angle,age:0,distance:stats.distance,area,count:angles.length,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
 }
 function update(delta,player,direction=[0,1]){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='moustache-medal');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;

   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,direction);const stats=moustacheMedalLevelStats(weapon.level);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(stats.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);
   if(!walls.length)continue;if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
   for(let i=walls.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=walls[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;if(b.age>s.duration+1e-8){walls.splice(i,1);continue;}
    const travel=Math.min(b.distance,b.age*s.speed);b.x=b.fromX+Math.cos(b.angle)*travel;b.y=b.fromY+Math.sin(b.angle)*travel;
    const radius=s.hitRadius*b.area;

import { decagrammatonReferenceStrokes } from './decagrammaton-ultimate.js';

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

export function createBadCookingAttack({random=Math.random}={}){

  function reset(){owner=null;active=false;elapsed=0;cycle=0;time=0;hits.clear();}

/** Ease into a swift central slash, then decelerate at the end of a 180ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â° sweep. */
export function umbrellaSwingAngle(aim, elapsed, duration = umbrellaSettings.duration) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, elapsed / duration));
  const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t ** 3 : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2;
  const arc = umbrellaSettings.arcDegrees * Math.PI / 180;
  return aim - arc / 2 + eased * arc;
}

/** Test the swept blade sector so fast swings cannot skip enemies between frames. */
export function umbrellaHits(player, enemy, fromAngle, toAngle, areaScale = 1) {
  areaScale *= umbrellaSettings.sizeScale;
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  const dx = body.x - player.x, dy = body.y - player.y;
  const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
  const radius = Math.max(body.rx, body.ry);
  if (distance > umbrellaSettings.reach * areaScale + radius) return false;
  if (distance + radius < umbrellaSettings.damageInnerRadius * areaScale) return false;
  // Subdivide the swept sector into blade segments at most 2 degrees apart.
 function draw(context,camera){if(!swing||!owner)return;const body=getCombatHitbox(owner,false),scale=s.range*swing.size/470;

   if(sprite?.complete&&sprite.naturalWidth)context.drawImage(sprite,8,8,370,392,-329*scale,-43*scale,370*scale,392*scale);context.restore();}
  for(let i=4;i>=1;i--){const age=swing.age-i*.018;if(age>=0)blade(age,.06+(4-i)*.025);}blade(swing.age,Math.min(1,swing.age/.025,(s.swingDuration-swing.age)/.025));
 }
 return {ready,update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled){swing=null;combo=null;}},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get active(){return Boolean(swing);}};
}

}

/** Conservative broadphase only; callers retain their existing exact collision tests. */
export function createEnemySpatialIndex(enemies, getBounds, cellSize=128) {
  const cells=new Map();
  enemies.forEach((enemy,order)=>{
    const b=getBounds(enemy),entry={enemy,order};
    for(let y=Math.floor((b.y-b.ry)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((b.y+b.ry)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((b.x-b.rx)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((b.x+b.rx)/cellSize);x++) {
        const key=x+','+y;
        let bucket=cells.get(key);if(!bucket)cells.set(key,bucket=[]);
        bucket.push(entry);
      }
  });
  return {querySegment(from,to,padding=0) {
    const found=new Set();
    for(let y=Math.floor((Math.min(from.y,to.y)-padding)/cellSize);y<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.y,to.y)+padding)/cellSize);y++)
      for(let x=Math.floor((Math.min(from.x,to.x)-padding)/cellSize);x<=Math.floor((Math.max(from.x,to.x)+padding)/cellSize);x++)
        for(const entry of cells.get(x+','+y)||[])found.add(entry);
    // Preserve Map insertion order: piercing limits and random damage rolls depend on it.
    return [...found].sort((a,b)=>a.order-b.order).map(entry=>entry.enemy);
  }};
}

import {maidForceSettings,maidForceLevelStats,attackTimeFormula,weaponSizeMultiplier} from './game-config.js';
import {ensureCombatStats,totalWeaponDamage,rollAttackDamage} from './combat-stats.js';

/** One-hit aimed scents; each accepted hit can launch a new scent at a nearby target. */
export function createMaidForceAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=maidForceSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,scents=[],shots=0,spreads=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;scents=[];shots=0;spreads=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,aim){const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),stats=maidForceLevelStats(weapon.level),size=s.area*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'maid-force',stats.count);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const angle=aim+(i-(count-1)/2)*.12,dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle),edge=1/Math.hypot(dx/body.rx,dy/body.ry)+3;
   scents.push({x:body.x+dx*edge,y:body.y+dy*edge,angle,age:0,isSpread:false,size,count,range:stats.range,chance:stats.chance,spreadMultiplier:stats.spreadMultiplier,baseMultiplier:1,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
 }
 function chain(b,target,body){if(random()>=b.chance)return null;
  const candidates=getAllEnemies().filter(enemy=>enemy.id!==target.id&&enemy.hp>0&&time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)>=s.hitCooldown-1e-8).map(enemy=>{const point=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return {enemy,point,distance:Math.hypot(point.x-body.x,point.y-body.y)};}).filter(t=>t.distance<=b.range).sort((a,c)=>a.distance-c.distance);
  const next=candidates[0];if(!next)return null;spreads++;
  return {...b,x:body.x,y:body.y,angle:Math.atan2(next.point.y-body.y,next.point.x-body.x),age:0,isSpread:true,baseMultiplier:b.baseMultiplier*b.spreadMultiplier};
 }
 function update(delta,player,aim=0){const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='maid-force');if(!weapon){reset();return;}if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;let left=delta,index=null;
  while(left>1e-8){if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,aim);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(maidForceLevelStats(weapon.level).interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);
   if(!scents.length)continue;if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);const pending=[];
   for(let i=scents.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=scents[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;b.x+=Math.cos(b.angle)*s.speed*dt;b.y+=Math.sin(b.angle)*s.speed*dt;const radius=s.radius*b.size;
    const targets=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id)||time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8)return false;const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);}).sort((a,c)=>{const t=getEnemyHurtbox(a),u=getEnemyHurtbox(c);return Math.hypot(t.x-from.x,t.y-from.y)-Math.hypot(u.x-from.x,u.y-from.y);});
    if(targets.length){const target=targets[0],body=getEnemyHurtbox(target);b.hits.set(target.id,time);
     const base=totalWeaponDamage(player,'maid-force',s.damage*b.baseMultiplier,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),hit=rollAttackDamage(player,base,random,{target,weaponId:'maid-force'});
     if(damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'maid-force'})!==false){const next=chain(b,target,body);if(next)pending.push(next);}scents.splice(i,1);
    }else if(b.age>=s.duration-1e-8)scents.splice(i,1);
   }
   // Descendants move on the next step, avoiding synchronous chain recursion.
   scents.push(...pending);
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){for(const b of scents){const radius=s.radius*b.size,alpha=Math.min(1,b.age/.04,(s.duration-b.age)/.15);context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.rotate(b.angle);context.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,alpha);
   const colors=b.isSpread?['rgba(239,252,255,.95)','rgba(169,231,255,.8)','rgba(112,199,255,.4)','rgba(112,199,255,0)']:['rgba(241,255,248,.95)','rgba(164,255,215,.8)','rgba(129,232,219,.4)','rgba(129,232,219,0)'];

# hosting-basics

This skill provides instructions and references for working with Firebase
Hosting, a fast and secure hosting service for your web app, static and dynamic
content, and microservices.

## Overview

Firebase Hosting provides production-grade web content hosting for developers.
With a single command, you can deploy web apps and serve both static and dynamic
content to a global CDN (content delivery network).

**Key Features:**

- **Fast Content Delivery:** Files are cached on SSDs at CDN edges around the
  world.
- **Secure by Default:** Zero-configuration SSL is built-in.
- **Preview Channels:** View and test changes on temporary preview URLs before
  deploying live.
- **GitHub Integration:** Automate previews and deploys with GitHub Actions.
- **Dynamic Content:** Serve dynamic content and microservices using Cloud
  Functions or Cloud Run.

## Hosting vs App Hosting

**Choose Firebase Hosting if:**

- You are deploying a static site (HTML/CSS/JS).
- You are deploying a simple SPA (React, Vue, etc. without SSR).
- You want full control over the build and deploy process via CLI.

**Choose Firebase App Hosting if:**

- You are using a supported full-stack framework like Next.js or Angular.
- You need Server-Side Rendering (SSR) or ISR.
- You want an automated "git push to deploy" workflow with zero configuration.

## Instructions

### 1. Configuration (`firebase.json`)

For details on configuring Hosting behavior, including public directories,
redirects, rewrites, and headers, see
[configuration.md](references/configuration.md).

### 2. Deploying

For instructions on deploying your site, using preview channels, and managing
releases, see [deploying.md](references/deploying.md).

### 3. Emulation

To test your app locally:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:start --only hosting
```

This serves your app at `http://localhost:5000` by default.

# Deploying to Firebase Hosting

## Standard Deployment

To deploy your Hosting content and configuration to your live site:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
```

This deploys to your default sites (`PROJECT_ID.web.app` and
`PROJECT_ID.firebaseapp.com`).

## Preview Channels

Preview channels allow you to test changes on a temporary URL before going live.

### Deploy to a Preview Channel

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:channel:deploy CHANNEL_ID
```

Replace `CHANNEL_ID` with a name (e.g., `feature-beta`). This returns a preview
URL like `PROJECT_ID--CHANNEL_ID-RANDOM_HASH.web.app`.

### Expiration

Channels expire after 7 days by default. To set a different expiration:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:channel:deploy CHANNEL_ID --expires 1d
```

## Cloning to Live

You can promote a version from a preview channel to your live channel without
rebuilding.

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:clone SOURCE_SITE_ID:SOURCE_CHANNEL_ID TARGET_SITE_ID:live
```

**Example:** Clone the `feature-beta` channel on your default site to live:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:clone my-project:feature-beta my-project:live
```

# Firebase Authentication setup

1. Open [Firebase Console](https://console.firebase.google.com/), create or select a project, and register a **Web app**.
2. In **Project settings > General > Your apps**, copy the web app's configuration into `firebase-config.js`. Keep any additional configuration properties supplied by Firebase. Never paste a service-account key into browser code.
3. In **Authentication > Sign-in method**, enable **Email/Password**.
4. In **Authentication > Settings > Authorized domains**, add your deployment hostname and `localhost` for development if needed.
5. Serve this folder over HTTP, for example with VS Code Live Server or `python -m http.server 8000`. Open `http://localhost:8000` instead of double-clicking the HTML file.
6. Create an account and confirm it appears in **Authentication > Users**. Close the tab, reopen the site, and verify login with the same account. Also check incorrect passwords, duplicate registration, and direct access to `project.html` while signed out.

The app uses Firebase's modular browser SDK, email/password accounts, and tab-scoped session persistence. Successful registration or login opens the intentionally empty workspace. Names are saved to the Firebase user's display name when possible. Existing local-demo accounts are not Firebase accounts; register them again.

The workspace redirect is a navigation guard. When project data is added, protect it with Firebase Security Rules or server-side ID-token validation; browser redirects do not authorize data access.

Reference: [Firebase email/password authentication](https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/web/password-auth), [browser SDK setup](https://firebase.google.com/docs/web/alt-setup).

## Guest access

The login page offers **Continue as guest**, followed by an explicit warning that upgrades, progress and other game data will not be saved. Cancel/Escape leaves the login page unchanged; confirmation opens the empty project workspace without Firebase sign-in or an anonymous account. Only a tab-scoped guest marker is stored; no game data is stored by guest access. Guest sessions never expose the admin Development link and are rejected by the Development guard, even if an account session exists in the browser. Successful account login/registration clears guest mode. When persistent gameplay storage is implemented, all save/load paths must respect `isGuestSession()` and keep guest runs transient.

Verification: `node tests/guest-session.test.cjs`. Guest access does not require enabling Firebase Anonymous Authentication.
