# Cloud Firestore Database and Operations

> [!IMPORTANT] **Security Rules Authoring (`firestore.rules`)** Whenever setting
> up a Firestore-backed app or creating/modifying `firestore.rules`, configure
> `"firestore": { "rules": "firestore.rules" }` in `firebase.json` and deploy
> `firestore.rules`
> (`npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only firestore:rules`), even if server
> routes use the Admin SDK:
>
> - **If subagent delegation AND the `firestore-rules-author` subagent are
>   available**: delegate authoring `firestore.rules` to the
>   `firestore-rules-author` subagent rather than writing `firestore.rules`
>   directly in the main agent.
> - **If subagent delegation is unavailable** (e.g., subagents not enabled in
>   the IDE) **OR `firestore-rules-author` is not installed**: read and follow
>   the `firestore-rules-creation` skill to write `firestore.rules` directly.

Before setting up dependencies, writing data models, or configuring security
rules, you MUST always identify the Firestore instance edition.

## 1. Instance Selection and Edition Detection

Run the following command to list current Firestore databases:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest firestore:databases:list
```

### A. Instance Found

1. For each database found, inspect its edition and details:

   ```bash
   npx -y firebase-tools@latest firestore:databases:get <database-id>
   ```

# Firestore Security Rules Creation

> [!IMPORTANT] **Subagent Delegation vs. Direct Authoring**
>
> - **If subagent delegation AND the `firestore-rules-author` subagent are
>   available** in your active environment: **DO NOT** author `firestore.rules`
>   directly in the main agent. Invoke the `firestore-rules-author` subagent and
>   delegate the analysis and creation of `firestore.rules` to it.
> - **If subagent delegation is unavailable** (e.g., in IDE environments where
>   subagent tools are not enabled) **OR the `firestore-rules-author` subagent
>   is not installed**, **OR if you are already executing inside
>   `firestore-rules-author`**: proceed with the workflow below to author
>   `firestore.rules` directly.

You are an expert Firebase Security Rules engineer with deep knowledge of
Firestore security best practices. Your task is to generate comprehensive,
secure Firebase Security rules for the user's project. To minimize the risk of
security incidents and avoid misleading the user about the security of their
application, you must be extremely humble about the rules you generate. Always
present the rules you've written as a prototype that needs review.

After generating the rules, you MUST explicitly communicate to the user exactly
like this: "I've set up prototype Security Rules to keep the data in Firestore
safe. They are designed to be secure for <explain reasons here>. However, you
should review and verify them before broadly sharing your app. If you'd like, I
can help you harden these rules."

### Workflow

Follow this structured workflow strictly:

#### Phase-1: Codebase Analysis

// Shared UI access policy for the project screen and development previews.
export const adminUid = 'k8ncp3tED8YjjxoTXHlYBSoxcFW2';

/** Return whether the signed-in Firebase user is the designated developer. */
export function isAdmin(user) {
  return user?.uid === adminUid;
}
import { getFirebaseAuth } from '../firebase-client.js';
import { isAdmin } from '../admin-access.js';
import { isGuestSession } from '../guest-session.js';

/** Reveal development content only after Firebase confirms the admin session. */
export async function requireAdmin() {
  if(document.documentElement?.dataset.runtime==='live')return (await import('./game-access.js')).requireGameAccess();
  const content = document.querySelector('#development-content');
  if (isGuestSession()) {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../project.html');
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const { auth, sdk } = await getFirebaseAuth();

    return await new Promise(resolve => {
      sdk.onAuthStateChanged(auth, user => {
        const allowed = isAdmin(user);
        content.hidden = !allowed;

        if (!allowed) {
          window.location.replace(user ? '../project.html' : '../index.html');
        }

        resolve(allowed);
      }, () => {
        content.hidden = true;
        window.location.replace('../index.html');
        resolve(false);
      });
    });
  } catch {
    content.hidden = true;
    window.location.replace('../index.html');
    return false;
  }
}

---
name: firebase-auth-basics
description: Guide for setting up and using Firebase Authentication. Use this skill when the user's app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access using auth rules.
compatibility: This skill is best used with the Firebase CLI, but does not require it. Firebase CLI can be accessed through `npx -y firebase-tools@latest`.
metadata:
  author: Google LLC
  category: Identity
---

## Prerequisites

- **Firebase Project**: Created via
  `npx -y firebase-tools@latest projects:create` (see `firebase-basics`).
- **Firebase CLI**: Installed and logged in (see `firebase-basics`).

## Core Concepts

Firebase Authentication provides backend services, easy-to-use SDKs, and
ready-made UI libraries to authenticate users to your app.

### Users

A user is an entity that can sign in to your app. Each user is identified by a
unique ID (`uid`) which is guaranteed to be unique across all providers. User
properties include:

- `uid`: Unique identifier.
- `email`: User's email address (if available).
- `displayName`: User's display name (if available).
- `photoURL`: URL to user's photo (if available).
- `emailVerified`: Boolean indicating if the email is verified.

### Identity Providers

Firebase Auth supports multiple ways to sign in:

- **Email/Password**: Basic email and password authentication.
- **Federated Identity Providers**: Google, Facebook, Twitter, GitHub,
  Microsoft, Apple, etc.
- **Phone Number**: SMS-based authentication.
- **Anonymous**: Temporary guest accounts that can be linked to permanent
  accounts later.
- **Custom Auth**: Integrate with your existing auth system.

Google Sign In is recommended as a good and secure default provider.

### Tokens

When a user signs in, they receive an ID Token (JWT). This token is used to
identify the user when making requests to Firebase services (Realtime Database,
Cloud Storage, Firestore) or your own backend.

- **ID Token**: Short-lived (1 hour), verifies identity.
- **Refresh Token**: Long-lived, used to get new ID tokens.

## Workflow

### 1. Provisioning

#### Option 1. Enabling Authentication via CLI

Only Google Sign In, anonymous auth, and email/password auth can be enabled via
CLI. For other providers, use the Firebase Console.

Configure Firebase Authentication in `firebase.json` by adding an 'auth' block:

```
{
  "auth": {
    "providers": {
      "anonymous": true,
      "emailPassword": true,
      "googleSignIn": {
        "oAuthBrandDisplayName": "Your Brand Name",
        "supportEmail": "support@example.com",
        "authorizedRedirectUris": [
          "https://my-project-id.firebaseapp.com/__/auth/handler",
          "http://localhost"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

> [!NOTE] If the Google Sign-In popup opens and immediately closes with the
> error `[firebase_auth/unauthorized-domain]`, it means the domain is not
> authorized. For local development, add `http://localhost` to
> `authorizedRedirectUris` in `firebase.json` (or ensure `localhost` is included
> in the **Authorized Domains** list in the Firebase Console under
> Authentication > Settings > Authorized domains). **CRITICAL**: Do NOT include
> the port number in `authorizedRedirectUris` (e.g., use `http://localhost`, NOT
> `http://localhost:9090` or `http://localhost:4000`), and do NOT include the
> protocol or port number in the Console Authorized Domains list (use
> `localhost`). Including a port number in `authorizedRedirectUris` causes
> `firebase deploy --only auth` to fail with `INVALID_AUTHORIZED_DOMAIN`.

**CRITICAL**: After configuring `firebase.json`, you MUST deploy the auth
configuration to the Firebase backend for the changes to take effect. This is
essential for auth providers like Google Sign-In, email/password, etc. to

# hosting-basics

This skill provides instructions and references for working with Firebase
Hosting, a fast and secure hosting service for your web app, static and dynamic
content, and microservices.

## Overview

Firebase Hosting provides production-grade web content hosting for developers.
With a single command, you can deploy web apps and serve both static and dynamic
content to a global CDN (content delivery network).

**Key Features:**

- **Fast Content Delivery:** Files are cached on SSDs at CDN edges around the
  world.
- **Secure by Default:** Zero-configuration SSL is built-in.
- **Preview Channels:** View and test changes on temporary preview URLs before
  deploying live.
- **GitHub Integration:** Automate previews and deploys with GitHub Actions.
- **Dynamic Content:** Serve dynamic content and microservices using Cloud
  Functions or Cloud Run.

## Hosting vs App Hosting

**Choose Firebase Hosting if:**

- You are deploying a static site (HTML/CSS/JS).
- You are deploying a simple SPA (React, Vue, etc. without SSR).
- You want full control over the build and deploy process via CLI.

**Choose Firebase App Hosting if:**

- You are using a supported full-stack framework like Next.js or Angular.
- You need Server-Side Rendering (SSR) or ISR.
- You want an automated "git push to deploy" workflow with zero configuration.

## Instructions

### 1. Configuration (`firebase.json`)

For details on configuring Hosting behavior, including public directories,
redirects, rewrites, and headers, see
[configuration.md](references/configuration.md).

### 2. Deploying

For instructions on deploying your site, using preview channels, and managing
releases, see [deploying.md](references/deploying.md).

### 3. Emulation

To test your app locally:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:start --only hosting
```

This serves your app at `http://localhost:5000` by default.

# Deploying to Firebase Hosting

## Standard Deployment

To deploy your Hosting content and configuration to your live site:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting
```

This deploys to your default sites (`PROJECT_ID.web.app` and
`PROJECT_ID.firebaseapp.com`).

## Preview Channels

Preview channels allow you to test changes on a temporary URL before going live.

### Deploy to a Preview Channel

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:channel:deploy CHANNEL_ID
```

Replace `CHANNEL_ID` with a name (e.g., `feature-beta`). This returns a preview
URL like `PROJECT_ID--CHANNEL_ID-RANDOM_HASH.web.app`.

### Expiration

Channels expire after 7 days by default. To set a different expiration:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:channel:deploy CHANNEL_ID --expires 1d
```

## Cloning to Live

You can promote a version from a preview channel to your live channel without
rebuilding.

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:clone SOURCE_SITE_ID:SOURCE_CHANNEL_ID TARGET_SITE_ID:live
```

**Example:** Clone the `feature-beta` channel on your default site to live:

```bash
npx -y firebase-tools@latest hosting:clone my-project:feature-beta my-project:live
```
import {getFirebaseAuth} from '../firebase-client.js';
import {isGuestSession} from '../guest-session.js';
import {hasAllContent} from '../admin-access.js';
import {createSaveStore} from './save-store.js';
import {contentFlag,saveContentRegistry} from './save-schema.js';
import {createCloudSaveAdapter} from './cloud-save.js';
import {configureItemUnlocks,refreshAccountUnlocks,isUnlockSimulation} from './item-catalog.js';
import {configureLootPersistence} from './exp-drops.js';
export async function initializeProgress(){
 let uid='guest',developer=false;if(!isGuestSession()){const {auth}=await getFirebaseAuth();uid=auth.currentUser?.uid||'guest';developer=hasAllContent(auth.currentUser);}
 const save=createSaveStore({uid,storage:sessionStorage});window.accountSave=save;
 if(uid!=='guest')try{await save.connect(await createCloudSaveAdapter(uid));}catch{save.offline();}
 const ids=()=>Object.keys(saveContentRegistry).filter(id=>save.snapshot.flags[contentFlag(id)]===1);
 // One-time read of the old per-UID local unlock list; never import another account or guest save.
 if(uid!=='guest'&&save.snapshot.flags['migration:local-unlocks-v1']!==1)try{for(const id of JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('orbitrail.items.'+uid)||'[]')){const key=contentFlag(id);if(key)save.set('flags',key,1);}save.set('flags','migration:local-unlocks-v1',1);}catch{}
 const storage={getItem:()=>JSON.stringify(ids()),setItem:(key,value)=>{for(const id of JSON.parse(value)){const flag=contentFlag(id);if(flag){save.set('flags',flag,1);if(save.snapshot.ranks['upgrade:'+id]===0)save.set('ranks','upgrade:'+id,1);}}}};
 configureItemUnlocks(storage,uid,{developer});save.subscribe(()=>refreshAccountUnlocks(ids()));
 window.addEventListener('online',()=>{if(uid!=='guest')void createCloudSaveAdapter(uid).then(adapter=>save.connect(adapter)).catch(()=>{});});
 window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{void save.flush();});return save;
}
export function bindAccountProgress(save,{players,runScore,getPlayer=()=>players[0]}){
 const slider=document.querySelector('#music-volume'),toggle=document.querySelector('#music-soundtrack-toggle');
 function syncAudio(data){if(Number(slider.value)!==data.preferences.musicVolume){slider.value=data.preferences.musicVolume;slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}if((toggle.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true'?1:0)!==data.preferences.soundtrackSecondary)toggle.click();}
 const walletChanged=wallet=>{for(const [key,value]of Object.entries(wallet))save.set('wallet',key,value);},scoreChanged=scores=>save.replace('scores',scores);
 function apply(data){syncAudio(data);configureLootPersistence({initial:data.wallet,onChange:walletChanged});runScore.configurePersistence(data.scores,scoreChanged);for(const player of players){player.abilityUpgradeRanks=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(data.ranks).map(([id,rank])=>[id.replace('upgrade:',''),rank]));for(const [type,field]of [['weapon','disabledWeaponIds'],['item','disabledItemIds']])player[field]=Object.keys(saveContentRegistry).filter(id=>saveContentRegistry[id]===type&&data.flags[contentFlag(id,true)]===1);}}
 apply(save.snapshot);save.subscribe(apply);
 slider.addEventListener('input',()=>save.set('preferences','musicVolume',Number(slider.value)));toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>save.set('preferences','soundtrackSecondary',toggle.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true'?1:0));
 // Only account-level settings are captured; run level, loadout, HP and map/timer stay fresh.
 const timer=setInterval(()=>{if(isUnlockSimulation())return;const player=getPlayer();for(const [id,rank]of Object.entries(player.abilityUpgradeRanks||{}))save.set('ranks','upgrade:'+id,rank);for(const [type,field]of [['weapon','disabledWeaponIds'],['item','disabledItemIds']])for(const id of Object.keys(saveContentRegistry).filter(id=>saveContentRegistry[id]===type))save.set('flags',contentFlag(id,true),(player[field]||[]).includes(id)?1:0);},1000);
 window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>clearInterval(timer),{once:true});

  6: 'Increase attack area by 20%.',

/** Offer only the next upgrade for an equipped, implemented weapon. */
function umbrellaChoices(player) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const weapon = getUmbrella(player);
  if (!weapon) return [];
  const level = weapon.level || 1;
  if (level < umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel) return [{ id: 'umbrella-level',
    name: `Plana's Umbrella ${upgradeLevelLabel(weapon,umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel)}`, weapon, category: 'Weapon', description: descriptions[level + 1] }];
  return [];
}

const arisDescriptions = {
  2: 'Increase beam size by 30%.',
  3: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  4: 'Increase damage by 50%.',
  5: 'Reduce attack cooldown by 0.5 seconds.',
  6: 'Increase beam size by 50%.',
  7: 'Fire an additional beam from behind.'
};

const luminousDescriptions={
  2:'Increase damage by 20%.',3:'Fire twice per base attack cycle.',4:'Increase damage by 30%.',
  5:'Fire three times per base attack cycle.',6:'Add knockback on hit.',7:'Fire four times per base attack cycle.'
};

/** Offer acquisition or the next Aris upgrade, plus existing umbrella choices. */
export function rollLevelUpgrades(player, {all=false}={}) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  const choices = [...umbrellaChoices(player),...characterSkillChoices(player)];

  const blocked=new Set((player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).flatMap(item=>

  });

    description: arisDescriptions[(weapon.level || 1) + 1]
  });
  const luminous=getLuminousNova(player);
  if(!blocked.has('luminous-nova')&&!luminous&&(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6)choices.push({
    id:'luminous-new',name:'Luminous Nova LV 1',weapon:createLuminousNovaWeapon(),category:'NEW Weapon',

    description:luminousDescriptions[(luminous.level||1)+1]});

/** Equipment definitions and account-local content unlocks. Guest unlocks stay in memory. */
let itemUnlockStore=null,itemUnlockKey=null;
const unlockedItems=new Set();
let developerUnlocks=false,simulateAccount=false;
const simulatedUnlocks=new Set();
/** Developer bypass never writes unlocks; simulation is a separate fresh test profile. */
export function setUnlockSimulation(enabled){
  const next=developerUnlocks&&Boolean(enabled);
  if(next&&!simulateAccount)simulatedUnlocks.clear();
  simulateAccount=next;
}
export function isUnlockSimulation(){return simulateAccount;}
export function isContentUnlocked(id,defaultUnlocked=false){
  return (developerUnlocks&&!simulateAccount)||defaultUnlocked||(simulateAccount?simulatedUnlocks:unlockedItems).has(id);
}
export function unlockContent(id){
  if(simulateAccount){simulatedUnlocks.add(id);return;}
  unlockedItems.add(id);
  try {itemUnlockStore?.setItem(itemUnlockKey,JSON.stringify([...unlockedItems]));} catch {}
}
/** Called only for actual boss defeats; normal enemies cannot satisfy this objective. */
export function unlockStageBossRewards(stage,bossType){
  if(stage===1&&bossType==='shiroko')unlockContent('saint-predator');
  if(stage===2&&bossType==='arisu')unlockContent('aris-laser');
  if(stage===3&&bossType==='iroha')unlockContent('maid-force');
  if(stage===4&&bossType==='neru')unlockContent('wakamo-bayonet');
}
export function configureItemUnlocks(storage,uid,{developer=false}={}) {
  developerUnlocks=Boolean(uid&&developer);simulateAccount=false;simulatedUnlocks.clear();
  itemUnlockStore=uid?storage:null;itemUnlockKey=uid?`orbitrail.items.${uid}`:null;unlockedItems.clear();
  try {for(const id of JSON.parse(itemUnlockStore?.getItem(itemUnlockKey)||'[]'))unlockedItems.add(id);} catch {}
}
export function refreshAccountUnlocks(ids){unlockedItems.clear();for(const id of ids)unlockedItems.add(id);}
export function unlockItem(id){unlockContent(id);}
export function isItemUnlocked(id){return isContentUnlocked(id);}
/** Unlocks are permanent eligibility; future Customize selections separately filter rewards. */
export function isItemRewardEnabled(player,id) {
  if(player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.consumedItemIds?.includes(id)))return false;
  const disabled=player.disabledItemIds;
  return !(disabled instanceof Set?disabled.has(id):Array.isArray(disabled)&&disabled.includes(id));
}
export function createMalkuthHat(awakened=false) {
  return {id:'malkuth-hat',name:"Malkuth's Hat",icon:'../sprites/items/malkuth.png',iconFit:true,iconCrop:{x:0,y:19,width:1254,height:1235},level:1,maxLevel:awakened?1:3,awakened,isSuper:awakened};
}

/** Session-first cache; cloud writes are debounced patches, never frame-by-frame saves. */
export function createSaveStore({uid='guest',storage=null,schedule=setTimeout,cancel=clearTimeout}={}){

 try{const cached=JSON.parse(storage?.getItem(key)||'null');if(cached){data=normalizeAccountSave(cached.data);dirty=cached.dirty||{};}}catch{}
 function snapshot(){return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));}
 function persist(){try{storage?.setItem(key,JSON.stringify({data,dirty}));}catch{}}
 function emit(){persist();for(const listener of listeners)listener(snapshot());}
 function queue(){if(!cloud)return;if(timer)return;timer=schedule(()=>{timer=null;void flush();},retryDelay);}

 function receive(remote){const normalized=normalizeAccountSave(remote);for(const [section,values]of Object.entries(dirty))normalized[section]=section==='scores'?values:{...normalized[section],...values};data=normalizeAccountSave(normalized);emit();}

  /** Crossfade to a new map without keeping inactive long recordings playing. */
  function setMap(id) {
    if (!mapTracks[id] || id === mapId) return;
    mapId = id;
    if(!menuActive)selectTrack();
  }

  /** Advance smooth gains and unload tracks that are no longer in use. */
  function update(delta) {
    if(suspended)return;
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) {
      track.elapsed += delta * 1000;
      const t = Math.min(1, track.elapsed / fadeDuration);
      const eased = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
      track.gain = track.from + (track.target - track.from) * eased;
      track.audio.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume * track.volumeScale * track.gain));
      if (t === 1 && track.target === 0) stopTrack(id, track);
    }
  }

  /** Honor browser audio activation by starting on the first user gesture. */
  function unlock(event) {
    if (event.target?.closest?.('#music-toggle')) return;
    if (unlocked || disposed) return;
    unlocked = true;
    selectTrack();
  }
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlock, { once: true });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', unlock, { once: true, capture: true });

  slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    volume = Number(slider.value) / 100;
    output.textContent = `${slider.value}%`;
    slider.style.setProperty('--volume-fill', `${slider.value}%`);
    for (const track of tracks.values()) track.audio.volume = volume * track.volumeScale * track.gain;
  });
  soundtrackToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    secondary = !secondary;
    soundtrackToggle.textContent = secondary ? 'Audio: Secondary' : 'Audio: Default';
    soundtrackToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(secondary));
    // This explicit gesture also unlocks playback, preserving the mute/pause setting.
    unlocked = true;
    if(!menuActive)selectTrack();
  });
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    // The first explicit click enables playback; later clicks toggle it.
    if (!unlocked || blocked) { unlocked = true; enabled = true; blocked = false; }
    else enabled = !enabled;
    button.textContent = enabled ? 'Pause music' : 'Play music';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(enabled));
    selectTrack();
  });

  /** Release every track immediately when leaving the preview. */
  function stopAll() {
    disposed = true;
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) stopTrack(id, track);
  }
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', stopAll);
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (!document.hidden) return;
    // Animation frames may pause in background tabs: don't leave old music playing.
    for (const [id, track] of tracks) {
      if (track.target === 0) stopTrack(id, track);
    }
  });
  output.textContent = `${slider.value}%`;
  function setMenu(active){if(menuActive===Boolean(active))return;menuActive=Boolean(active);selectTrack();}
  function setSuspended(value){suspended=Boolean(value);for(const track of tracks.values()){if(suspended)track.audio.pause();else if(enabled&&track.target>0)track.audio.play().catch(()=>{});}}
  return { setMap, setMenu, update, stopAll, setSuspended };

  function setPaused(enabled) {

import {createBitmapText} from './bitmap-font.js';

/** Account-owned UI settings use stable 0/1 flag IDs, alongside content flags. */
export function initializeAccountSettings(save){
 const definitions=[['setting:shift-back','Shift to go back'],['setting:pause-on-tab-leave','Pause when leaving tab']];
 const controls=[];
 for(const panel of document.querySelectorAll('.title-settings, #pause-settings')){
  const group=document.createElement('div');group.className='account-setting-toggles';
  for(const [id,label]of definitions){
   const row=document.createElement('label'),input=document.createElement('input'),text=document.createElement('canvas');
   input.type='checkbox';input.setAttribute('aria-label',label);input.dataset.setting=id;
   createBitmapText(text,{variant:'font2',scale:1,wrap:true,maxWidth:250}).setText(label);
   row.append(input,text);group.append(row);controls.push({id,input});
   input.addEventListener('change',()=>save.set('flags',id,input.checked?1:0));
  }
  panel.append(group);
 }
 function sync(data){for(const {id,input}of controls)input.checked=data.flags[id]!==0;}
 sync(save.snapshot);save.subscribe(sync);
 // Registered before menu key handlers so Shift can be disabled consistently.
 window.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
  if(event.key==='Shift'&&save.snapshot.flags['setting:shift-back']===0){event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();}
 },true);
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
  if(document.hidden&&save.snapshot.flags['setting:pause-on-tab-leave']!==0)document.querySelector('#pause-game')?.click();
 });
}
